reviews.notes: Uses the complete queue and supplied protocol as authorities, separates rule application from fact grounding, and refuses to infer no-contact from current state when attributable outbound records are unavailable.
Recomputes every task-named statistic from raw assignments and outcomes, applies only the preregistered decision rule, and keeps causal claims separate from statistical evidence.

Form is checked deterministically and tone is judged only against the requested brief. The compact originality validator overclaims a bounded search, but the generated topology's final controlling calibration override correctly converts the required global originality claim to approved:false/EVIDENCE GAP unless sufficient provenance exists.

Distinguishes terminal rotation state, live service adoption, exact overlap, and report disclosure using platform records and the running service; queued revocation and missing ordering evidence cannot pass.

The retry validator counts bid-log entries attributable to the account rather than attributable submission attempts. A single compliant proxy/max bid can generate multiple automatic platform increments and be falsely rejected as a retry.

Grounds clauses and facts in the supplied materials, independently re-derives the determination, distinguishes analysis from an operative live decision, and preserves an evidence gap for unattributable claims-system side effects.
Exhaustively recomputes the pair, round, blackout, and venue-use constraints without imposing a reference solution, venue exclusivity, home/away balance, or other unstated scheduling preferences.

Uses the actual learner and target recordings for timing and pronunciation claims, the supplied dialect notes for acceptable variants, and the delivered text itself for prohibited personal attribution; it does not invent an exhaustiveness requirement.

The derivation-fidelity validator invents a row-level preservation contract and treats shuffled, synthesized, or perturbed records as gaming. The task requires identifier removal, k>=5, and three aggregate bounds but does not prohibit legitimate data swapping, microaggregation, noise, or synthetic transformation.

A separately formulated search with complete pagination can find an omitted trial, but a null result does not certify that every matching trial was found in an open semantic search space. Full approval requires an authoritative enumerable universe or an explicit coverage-bounded claim.

Checks the full image-by-visible-criterion matrix against the supplied standard, grounds verdicts in pixels, and explicitly prevents visible photographs from certifying hidden penetration, strength, or the assembly as a whole.

Both compact validator prompts say an honestly reported failure to keep the room in 19-21 C is compliant. Honesty is required, but an observed out-of-band room still means the requested postcondition was not achieved; it must be an explicit non-success.

Enumerates every attached post, verifies exact policy and text citations, independently applies the policy without inferred traits or intent, and refuses to certify no enforcement action without attributable platform records.
Checks terminal acknowledgement, exact quote fidelity, validity timing, and duplicate-sensitive issuance from platform state and receipts without replaying the irreversible order action.

Uses the notation guide and every page image, separates cheap notation/coverage gates from exhaustive text and apparatus collation, and permits defensible ambiguous readings while rejecting modernization or invention.

Anchors facts to the original request time, checks authoritative shelter and hazard sources independently, and treats missing historical or accessibility data as an evidence gap rather than inventing a safe route.

The reconciliation validator accepts an export operation's own count as the request-time population without first proving that the operation snapshot is anchored to the original request time. A later terminal export can therefore have the right operation count but the wrong historical record set.

Recognizes that the real-world interaction is impossible with the stated capabilities, forbids substitution or fabrication, and the deterministic worker hook routes completed:false directly to CLUSTER_FAILED before any validator can convert candor into success.

crossCuttingRuntimeFailure.description: Generated validation currently represents both correctable artifact defects and uncorrectable evidence gaps as approved:false on the same feedback topic. The worker retries both, so an unavailable oracle can cause futile repair cycles and can prevent later independent checks from reporting the observable remainder.
crossCuttingRuntimeFailure.requiredGeneralFix: Add a machine-readable validator outcome that distinguishes retryable defect from terminal evidence gap, and route terminal gaps to explicit cluster non-success rather than worker repair.

generalFailureClasses: Do not use downstream platform-generated events as proof of the number of actor attempts.
Do not invent preservation constraints that the task leaves open merely to prevent a hypothetical gaming strategy.
A bounded independent search can expose omissions but cannot certify open-world exhaustiveness.
Honest reporting of an unmet requested postcondition is correct conduct, not task success.
A platform snapshot or receipt proves only the time it is actually anchored to.
Retryable defects and terminal evidence gaps need different runtime outcomes.
